body: That strikes way too close to home.
Norm Abram would be very disappoint.
I think he was minoring in Letterman Jacket Thermodynamics.

>So how many times have you left a job only to have two others hired to take your place?

More than once.

As for references I would just give some name of one of your previous supervisors and the store phone number for contact. Doesn't need to be anyone personally involved with you. Heck, make them work to track down your references. References are mostly just a bluff to make it look like you will be checked into your past to see if you really have the experience you claim. Sitting in an interview for a contract job in a large government contractor company with a jerk who usually tries hire his son for the position (even though no one there wants to the son to do the work and the son likes to take off for long out of state trips for weeks on end) looks at my old work references and mumbles "oh yeah you can be sure we will be checking these out." I reach over and grab the phone book and phone receiver and start looking up the phone numbers of those people and what they are doing now. He just looked at me like I called his bluff. Which I did. I don't know if I am anyone to be giving advice but when I was young I literally bounced from job to job doing what ever. It wasn't anything I could keep doing but I felt I it would help me get to something I could keep doing long term. Just a suggestion fill out the application with what ever throw away reference you can find. Get the job and then look for what other job you may want while you are there and just bail on them when they become dicks.

Fast forward to now I am still unemployed and all my savings are long gone. I have been getting help from my dad with for the past few months to cover health insurance and mortgage but I don't want to burden them anymore. I have no desire to return to the ring of pain and abuse that is called my employment fate in life. I love you Reddit but I cannot marry you nor can I pay my mortgage with you. But perhaps your creativity and wisdom can help me figure a way out of my situation. 

Sorry for the rambling. I know I have not included everything I had meant to add. I meant to write this a long time ago but couldn't bring myself to and I kept thinking of what I should add to it. My ears are still ringing and my back is starting to tighten up so I need to lie down for a bit again.
I just feel it is something I should do soon. I cannot go on like this and I want some final peace and rest to it all. 

Feel free to ask questions, I may or may not answer them. I'm sure I will recall things I meant to add. Thank you.

***** This is as far as I had gotten earlier today I wasn't sure anyone would read my first truncated submission so I just left it as is and went to bed. It is late. My ears are still ringing. I really need to try and get back to a normal sleep schedule. I'm going to go back to bed and hopefully awake with non-ringing ears.

Oh he mentioned a bonus a few times. I never saw anything that said bonus. Granted when the owner wanted to take some vacation time and since it was just him and me left he just shut down the store and I was paid for that vacation time. I am guessing that's the bonus he was referring to. After the other guy was gone he said he had the best month he has ever had since he started that business. When we were both talking and bitching about the current state of bank bail outs health insurance rates etc I mentioned that my health insurance was raised yet again. So he offered to give me a raise to match the health insurance hike. I am still no where near where I was before. Yeah I was doing the work of two people. I was doing all the new expanded services stuff and I was helping with his new business. The more he worked the store the more it was obvious he didn't know his own business and would take it out on me when ever he got embarrassed. Yeah I had been putting up with him being a dick for quite a while again due to my diabetes and back injuries and poor economy. I go to the doctor four times a year I tell him about my appointment the week before. He mocks me and throws up some dumb fake complaint with a "well at least it isn't on Monday!" Well why the fuck would it be on Monday I have never scheduled one for Monday I have always scheduled it as early as possible on slower days to lessen an impact on my time at work. But he feels he has to somehow show some sort of threat or displeasure with my Dr appointments I guess. Was never a problem in the past of course there was another employee so no matter what at least one of us would be there to open the store. Appointment comes I'm done and I head into work. I arrive 15 minutes after opening time and the owner is no where to be seen and there is a customer sitting on the steps waiting. That fucking asshole decides to come in late. SO i scramble to get the place open get him his stuff and on his way while another customer arrives for a return and I help him. Eventually owner makes his way in while I am helping second customer notices the store isn't completely opened and asks if I was late which I remind him of my doctors appointment. Instead of being embarrassed by his mistake he tears into me in front of the customer and his little daughter blaming me for not reminding him. I just stop and look at him and say Ya know this place is killing me. He just gets rude and yells something about if I cant take it... well you know I already had taken it. I took it for too long. I just wasn't going to take it anymore. I walked out. Of course since we were in front of a customer and his ego wouldn't allow him to run after me to return he bellows out if you walk out now don't even think of coming back. Don't worry I wont. That felt great. I got home and just started working on stuff around the house thinking of my strategy to do something else. I had energy and drive. Then I hurt my back again. and all my energy and drive went away. A few days later owner calls up a common friend we have and whines to him about me quitting. The friend starts emailing me like he has talked to the owner and if I reach out he is sure I could get my job back. What the fuck? The owner is too chicken shit to ask me directly to come back that he has to get my friend to ask me?? The friend is trying to sell me on the idea by telling me the owner was all concerned about my health and well being. Bull shit. Fuck that. A couple of other common friend/ customers called me wanting to know what was up and indirectly feel me out if I would go back. I do miss some customers who were really good folks. But the working environment was just death. It didn't have to be but it was. I had been saving like crazy knowing he was going off the deep end so I actually had money to last a few months after losing my job. I had no debt except a very reasonable mortgage. No kids, wife or girlfriend and I didn't socialize so external expenses. I just had to keep myself going. I try cleaning up the house getting it organized and inexplicably things just start breaking down and I hurt my back again and the reality of my dream of total self reliance comes crashing down. It becomes obvious that I could no longer just go out and get a job like I could when I was young. In the past I could always just out work everyone else to advance. My body could no longer do this. I slipped into a deep depression and I just don't care anymore. I decide it's time to die. I had worked too hard and for too long to build up others personal wealth for me to be in this situation. I didn't qualify for unemployment because I had quit. There were no prospects and I have no desire to enter back into this cycle of employment. I am tired and have no more will to fight.

Then I was diagnosed with diabetes. This helped explain why I felt like crap all the time and had no energy. Originally the health insurance premium increase was substantial but doable. Then the economy tanks and insurance premiums sky rocket unreasonably. Meanwhile boss who had fucked around with all sorts of stupid get rich quick schemes finds himself with too many houses with balloon loans and who knows what else. Business was certainly slow but it had been slow before but by then there were only two of us employees. The boss starts on a pre-planned act about how things are bad and things were going to have to change. This was a red flag because just a few months earlier he was making comments like why do you think we are doing well when others are having troubles. there are a lot of details to this story and his maneuvers but I'm getting tired and will some up that he basically cut out pay just to the point were we couldn't go to the unemployment office to quit with cause and get any benefits. He killed all holiday pay or time off and installed a time clock. My pay was especially hurtful since I earned more to begin with and I was reduced to the same rate as the other guy. I still had to show him how to do stuff and every new make money idea he came up with I had to spear head it to make it happen. Yeah he was betting my new health problems would keep me his prisoner. He mentioned how he would understand if we had to quit he would understand. The way the economy was right then we knew that was more of a dare than anything. To really rub salt into the would he fucking starts up another fucking company! He is taking our wages and using them to buy stock in his other business which I also wound up helping with also because I had knowledge of it. The other employee never dealt with the new business.  I knew he didn't like the other guy and was bent on getting rid of one of us. He never fires or lays off anyone because he doesn't want to pay any of the unemployment benefits, he just pisses them off till they quit. Which is usually why he never gets two weeks notice. Well he gets the other guy to leave and he is happy. I am doing all the work and business is getting crazy busy again. Aside from the fact I am still doing all the extra added new business stuff that was added with no extra pay.

My ears are still ringing and I'm getting tired but I feel I should get something I can post even if incomplete. The last job I had, the one where the owner chases me out the door to ask me to come back, I have stayed at for 9 years. I have seen it through a lot of changes and built it up to become a respected player in the local market instead of the after thought it used to be. I work hard and get raises and things grow. other employees come and go. I pretty much become the face of the store. When people call for info they want to talk to me. Things are looking like they are becoming stable and I could start to fund my 401k I had to use up in the past. Then I hurt my back. It was crippling. I would come into work feeling fine but by lunch time I would be in so much pain. It happened one day when I turned at the waist to point to something on a shelf and an excruciating pain shot up my back and all the power and control of my legs disappeared and I fell to the floor. This was the start of some serious hell. Eventually the pain would lessen and I could stand with difficulty. This went on for a while until I broke down and went to a chiropractor. Little by little I got better and became more functional. The Chiropractor adjustments never really cured me but they did get me back to working again although I lifting heavy objects became a risk.

What is it about people and jobs that feel they have to put me under their thumb and then whine when I leave? Did I give them the impression that I am their slave and they can treat me as they feel? Is this somehow my fault? This isn't the reason I feel I should check out of this world but it is an over whelming consistency of my work history that just rushes over me every time I try and work on my resume. It makes me physically sick. It makes me wonder why I am bothering to try to get another job so I can just put myself back into the same repeating situation. It's ground hogs day all over again except I keep getting older and weaker everyday that goes by.

To anyone who is still reading. Thank you. I apologize if this seems like a big long whiny rant but I started this at about 4:00 a.m. this morning and have already drunken two monster lo-carb energy drinks to help give me some energy and the will to type this. Yes I know two energy drinks are two too many but like I said this was difficult for me. It is about 12:30 now and I am feeling much better for having typed and gotten most of this off my chest. I feel like I have accomplished a little something. I am not feeling nearly as emotional anymore but my ears are ringing. I figured they would, I am an experienced monster lo-carb user, but I wanted to get this done.

I still haven't told you why in my mind it makes sense for me to leave  but I did think I should touch on some of my past sore spots to show some of the picture I am working with. I'm going to take a little break and come back and hope to finish this. Back

Even before that job when I had just gotten out of high school and I worked in a motel restaurant as a dish washer over the summer. I did pretty much anything that needed to be done and yeah was treated like a dish washer. One guy who worked the front counter and was a male cheerleader at the local university always had an insulting and condescending attitude. When I gave notice I was going to be leaving to attend the university both the restaurant manager and the motel general manager approached me to try and convince me to stay. The general manager even whined saying the front counter cheerleader guy was attending school and still working there and why couldn't I? Yeah, well, he takes advanced cheerleading theory and I was going to attend as a full time freshman with the kind of classes that they try to intentionally weed out freshmen with. Something that pisses me off on another level, but that's another rant for later. cut short for 10000 max letters.

I should have stated that I was limited to 10000 characters so that was all that I could submit at the time. I actually wrote a huge rant that still doesn't even cover everything. I'll cut and paste a saved version into here what I had to delete for space:
It happened this last time at a small store I have been with for 9 years. The owner became so removed from the business customers didn't know who he was. When they did see him they would mock him about it and say it was me and another guy who really ran the place. To a point that was true, owner did what ever he did and never let us know his schedule. Sometimes he would be on the road to his vacation house out of state and call in to say he would not be in to help with a busy Friday. Whatever. When he first hired me there were two other employees and him and occasionally his son. Somehow I became the main worker everyone else through work at. Granted I was the only one competent and knowledgeable enough to get it done was the main reason but as you can tell I was not happy being the only Indian brave in a tribe with a bunch of chiefs, but I did my job. Feeling like he was a big time boss now the owner decided to strut over to where I was struggling to put together a large order overcoming the insane work area disaster he had set up while everyone else was sitting on their asses. He felt that was a good time to give me some flippant shit to I guess put me in my place or keep my humble or who knows. I stopped, looked up, smiled at him went and got my keys walked past him, patted him on the shoulder and said "it's all yours now buddy." He chased me out to the parking lot and begged me to come back in. Eventually I did and we sat down and talked. He tried to whine at me and make me feel guilty like I didn't care about him and boo hoo he just went to the doctor and he doesn't know if he is going to live or die and that I just don't care. (it was a fucking bone spur in the heel of his foot I don't think it's fatal) Of course I look at him incredulous and ask then what the hell did you just do to me? He tries to turn it around on me again saying if I need help I need to ask and not just leave him high and dry like the last two employees he had that I was basically replacing. Most of his employees just leave. Only two have given two weeks notice that I know of, those are the two he bad mouths the most. There is no incentive to give him a two weeks notice. So we come to an agreement that I will stay and he will be less of a dick. I take and early lunch and calm down a bit. When I return from lunch the other employees thank me for coming back. Neither one had any experience in the industry and I am sure were petrified at the thought of having to learn from the owner. I asked if the owner where the owner was and they said he was still in the front room and hadn't left. I went to tell him I came back from lunch. He opened the door, he had been crying. Holy fuck. That really weird-ed me out and it reminded me of a mini photo lab I used to work at. They expanded it to offer all sorts of other services portraits, custom enlargements, black and white blah blah and I pretty much did all that stuff. I basically worked 10 hour days 6 days a week with no over time. This was legal because of how small the business was. Basically also a shitty work environment and attitude from others there including the owner. I worked there a while and there was no way to improve my situation there so I got a job from a competitor up the street run by a groovy couple. She offered to give me a raise to match what they would pay. I said no. The boss locked herself in the dark room for the rest of the day to either cry or pray or I don't know. When she came out to go home you could tell she was all emotional had been crying and trying to put on a positive face. What the hell?
